svg.title: GCP Cloud Mindmap — Google Cloud Master Vault — 12 architecture domains and 91 catalogue topics
svg.desc: A detailed Google Cloud architecture mind map in the AWS Master Vault visual style. Twelve named architecture domains connect to a central GCP Master Vault hub. Each domain contains its canonical learning topics.
svg.text: A PRACTICAL GUIDE TO GCP MASTER VAULT
12 ARCHITECTURE DOMAINS • 91 LEARNING TOPICS • ONE CANONICAL HOME PER TOPIC
Google Cloud architecture services • 12 domains • 91 topics • Created by Rahul Tripathi
